stories.title: Çankırı'da orman yangını! Havadan ve karadan müdahale ediliyor

en.title: Forest fire in Çankırı! Response underway from air and ground
en.summary: A forest fire broke out near Yumaklı village in the Çerkeş district of Çankırı, with authorities responding using both aerial and ground-based firefighting methods.

stories.title: AP Raportöründen "Ailem Güvende" operasyonu açıklaması: Temel hakların ihlali

en.title: AP Reporter statement on "My Family is Safe" operation: Human rights violation
en.summary: The European Parliament's Turkey rapporteur characterized an operation targeting LGBT+ organizations and activists across 15 cities as a violation of fundamental rights.

en.title: BREAKING... Alarming forest fire in Arnavutköy! Aerial response continues against the flames
en.summary: A forest fire erupted in Istanbul's Arnavutköy district, with ground crews unable to access the affected area, prompting firefighting teams to continue aerial operations.

stories.title: Son dakika... İstanbul Arnavutköy'de orman yangını

en.title: Breaking news... Forest fire in Istanbul Arnavutköy
en.summary: A forest fire occurred in a wooded area of Arnavutköy, with aerial response initiated since ground access to the fire zone was unavailable.

stories.title: Adres şaşırtmayacak... Mersin Limanı'ndaki geminin altından paket paket kokain çıktı!

en.title: Cocaine packages found beneath ship at Mersin Port
en.summary: Turkish authorities seized 350 kilograms of cocaine valued at 1.5 billion Turkish lira hidden under a cargo ship at Mersin Port, with nine suspects detained in connection with the case.

stories.title: "Vanlı Kara Haydar"ın İstanbul'da yakalanan eşi Van'a götürüldü

en.title: Wife of 'Van's Kara Haydar' captured in Istanbul transferred to Van
en.summary: The wife of Mehmet Fatih Tançalan, known as 'Vanlı Kara Haydar', was captured in Istanbul and transferred to Van following her detention related to social media posts.

stories.title: Yıllarca birbirlerine 'kardeşim' dediler: Gerçek 30 yıl sonra ortaya çıktı

en.title: Called each other 'sister' for years: Truth emerged 30 years later
en.summary: Two women adopted from different orphanages in India and taken to the Netherlands were reunited years later, discovering the truth about their relationship after decades.

stories.title: Taksinin bagajı cephanelik çıktı: Eyüpsultan'da 108 tabancayla yakalanan 2 şüpheli tutuklandı

en.title: Taxi's trunk became an arsenal: 2 suspects arrested with 108 pistols in Eyüpsultan
en.summary: Turkish gendarme forces found 108 pistols worth approximately 15 million lira in a taxi's trunk during an operation against arms smuggling in Eyüpsultan, leading to the arrest of two suspects.

stories.title: İstanbul'da taksinin bagajı cephanelik gibi çıktı

en.title: Istanbul taxi's trunk found loaded with firearms
en.summary: A search of a taxi's trunk in Istanbul's Eyüpsultan district uncovered 108 pistols. The weapons had significant market value.

stories.title: "Vanlı Kara Haydar"ın eşi Çağla Öz Tançalan Van'a götürüldü

en.title: Wife of "Van's Kara Haydar" transferred to Van
en.summary: Çağla Öz Tançalan, wife of Mehmet Fatih Tançalan known as "Vanlı Kara Haydar," was transferred to Van after being detained in Istanbul. Tançalan had been arrested following social media activity.

stories.title: Çocukluk arkadaşlarının kardeş olduğu DNA testiyle ortaya çıktı

en.title: DNA test reveals childhood friends are biological sisters
en.summary: Two women adopted by different families and raised in the Netherlands after being born in India discovered through DNA testing that they were biological sisters. Their childhood intuition about their connection was confirmed nearly 30 years later.

stories.title: Mersin Limanı'nda gemide gizlenmiş 350 kilo kokain ele geçirildi: 9 şüpheliye adli işlem

en.title: 350 kilograms of cocaine seized on ship at Mersin Port: legal proceedings against 9 suspects
en.summary: Turkish authorities recovered 350 kilograms of hidden cocaine, diving equipment, and underwater scooter materials from a vessel arriving from South America at Mersin Port. Legal proceedings were initiated against 9 suspects connected to the case.

stories.title: KPSS Alan Bilgisi sınavları tamamlandı: Sonuçlar 7 Ekim'de

en.title: KPSS Subject Knowledge exams completed: Results on 7 October
en.summary: The Public Personnel Selection Exam's subject knowledge sessions administered by the Centre for Measurement, Selection and Placement have concluded. Results will be announced on 7 October and remain valid for two years.

stories.title: Üç dev bankadan yatırımcıya ortak uyarı: Piyasalarda oyun değişiyor

en.title: Joint warning to investors from three major banks: The game is changing in markets
en.summary: While artificial intelligence investments maintain strong momentum in global markets, high interest rates, energy prices and geopolitical tensions are increasing risks for investors. UBS, Citi and JPMorgan have issued aligned warnings about market conditions.

en.title: VAR official confirmed for Galatasaray-Kocaelispor match
en.summary: The video assistant referee for the Trendyol Super League week 5 match between Galatasaray and Kocaelispor has been appointed as Slovenian Matej Jug.

stories.title: Sosyal medya hesaplarına sermaye piyasası soruşturması

en.title: Capital markets investigation into social media accounts
en.summary: Authorities are investigating social media posts that could mislead investors in capital markets. The Bakırköy Chief Public Prosecutor's office has initiated an investigation and instructed gendarmerie to identify persons behind the accounts.

stories.title: Bakan Kurum paylaştı: İşte kiraya verilecek TOKİ evleri

en.title: Minister Kurum shared: Here are the TOKİ houses to be rented
en.summary: Turkey's housing agency is launching a rental social housing project in Istanbul with initial rents starting at 10,000 lira for 1,071 units in the first phase.
